description: The SEO manager and the starting point for any SEO or organic-search task. Decides what the user needs, holds the shared rules, and routes data work to gsc-insights (Search Console, weekly digest), seo-tech-audit (crawl, index, speed, backlog) and ahrefs (keywords, SERPs, domains, backlinks). Carries playbooks for structured data, site architecture, programmatic pages, comparison and alternatives pages, AI search visibility and an audit checklist. Use when someone asks anything about SEO, organic traffic, what to improve or write, schema markup, site structure, internal linking, AI Overviews, ChatGPT or Perplexity visibility, llms.txt, or title tags and meta descriptions. Triggers: "SEO", "organic search", "why did search traffic drop", "what should we improve in SEO", "schema markup", "JSON-LD", "site structure", "internal linking", "comparison pages", "alternatives page", "programmatic SEO", "visibility in ChatGPT", "AI Overviews", "GEO", "AEO", "llms.txt", "title and description".
